name: newsroom-extension
description: Full-stack AI newsroom toolkit for investigative journalism and newsroom operations.

commands.name: investigate
commands.description: Launch an investigation — entity mapping, dependency tracing, OSINT, FOIA, and libel-proof documentation
commands.prompt:
Investigate: @$1

Load the `investigative-journalist` skill and follow its full framework — master file construction, structural dependency mapping, OSINT source inversion, FOIA engineering, corporate veil piercing, temporal anomaly sequencing, and zero-error defensive audit.

commands.name: copy-review
commands.description: Line-edit for readability, accessibility, and SEO without touching facts
commands.prompt:
Review: @$1

Load the `copy-review` skill. Focus on readability, accessibility, SEO metadata, typographical errors, rhythm, and ad placement conflicts. Do NOT alter facts, sourcing, or editorial judgment — that belongs to `/editor-review`.

commands.name: editor-review
commands.description: Final editorial review — fact verification, legal risk, sourcing, publication readiness
commands.prompt:
Editor review: @$1

Load the `final-editor-review` skill. Verify all assertions against sources, assess libel/legal risk, check attribution quality, and sign off on publication readiness.

commands.name: publish
commands.description: Safe single-article deployment with pre-flight checklist
commands.prompt:
Publish: @$1

Load the `publish-article` skill. Pre-flight checklist: legal sign-off, fact check completion, author/editor sign-offs. Deploy safely with post-publish verification.

commands.name: publish-series
commands.description: Coordinated deployment of a multi-part investigative series
commands.prompt:
Publish series: @$1

Load the `publish-series` skill. Coordinate sequential release with editorial gates between parts, cross-article linking, and audience engagement tracking.

commands.name: distribute
commands.description: Generate platform-optimized social posts from a published article
commands.prompt:
Distribute: @$1

Load the `social-distributor` skill. Generate platform-optimized posts (Twitter, LinkedIn, etc.) with legally defensible copy and attribution.

commands.name: archive
commands.description: Ingest raw OSINT into a queryable database with chain of custody
commands.prompt:
Archive: @$1

Load the `data-archivist` skill. Transform raw documents into structured, queryable databases with documented chain of custody.
